metadata.description: A lean, curated collection of iOS and Swift Agent Skills: sixteen skills spanning Apple Foundation Models, Instruments profiling, Liquid Glass, SwiftUI performance, Swift TDD, bug diagnosis, code review, and Xcode tooling - plus a vetted registry of the best skills from across the community.

plugins.description: Sixteen iOS/Swift Agent Skills: Apple Foundation Models, Instruments profiling, SwiftUI Liquid Glass and performance, view refactoring, Swift 6.2 concurrency, Swift TDD, bug diagnosis, code review, domain modeling, Xcode merge conflicts, pre-commit hooks, Apple docs research, simulator debugging, App Store changelogs, and GitHub issue fix flow.
